title: Sync names, read values on demand
lede: Syncing lists secret names and versions from Google; a value is fetched from Google only when an admin clicks View, and access policies live in Privilege.

edges.label: define who may read, until when

steps.title: Create the hub
steps.what: An admin names the hub, chooses Project (recommended), Organization or Folder, and pastes a Google service account key.
steps.why: The Secret Manager Admin role is required and the Cloud Resource Manager API must be enabled, or sync shows 0 secrets.

steps.title: Sync reads structure, not values
steps.what: Syncing calls Google to search projects, list secrets and list secret versions, and reads names and versions only.
steps.why: A value is fetched from Google only when an admin clicks View, using the hub's service account.

steps.title: Access is defined in Privilege
steps.what: The hub's Policy button picks a secret, chooses Read or Write, names users or groups and sets an expiry; creating it makes no call to Google.
steps.why: The Access Summary tab lists policies with secret, permission, users and expiry. The pasted key was observed once in clear text in the console audit feed.
